items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I got a letter from Sullivan to join him with a band in Danville, Virginia.

ctx.x: And I think I went from there to -- I went to -- oh, I carried my wife home to see my mother. I went to Arkansas to see my mother. And then, while I was down there, I got a letter from Sullivan to join him with a band in Danville, Virginia.
